title: Objects arrive
seen: Two teak chairs, two books and a few gulmohar petals fall from above into a nearly empty dawn atmosphere. The house is fully hidden.
camera: Lock the exterior camera. Move the objects downward on scroll; introduce no orbit.
fog: Dense fog hides the destination and the entire building.

title: Into the house
seen: The same objects descend and become faint. A small line reads “Make room for what comes next.”
camera: Hold the same camera; continue the same trajectories without spawning replacements.
fog: The objects disappear before they could intersect the closed roof; the landing and relocation into rooms happen unseen.

title: Dawn / house at rest
seen: The confirmed house appears intact, with the stepped roof, teak windows, grey gate and two sparse gulmohars. Four corners read SPACE / Book a call / Scroll / 06:00 IST.
camera: Hold the reference frontal street camera; use this as the exterior framing master.
fog: Fog reveals the facade while suppressing neighbours and the street edges.

title: The first separation
seen: Floors begin parting vertically; fine survey lines in empty space describe the separation. No geometry rotates or breaks.
camera: Same azimuth, focal length and facade registration; move floor groups only.
fog: Low fog hides the basement and the ground contact.

title: A house for startup people
seen: The parting reaches its widest point. Copy: “A house for startup people. Four levels. Room to belong.” Seam glow is removed in this refinement.
camera: Keep the street camera fixed; the roof and floor groups lift along their original vertical axes.
fog: Rising fog begins masking the section edges and the lowest floor.

title: An empty breath
seen: Only a very faint upper silhouette and the corner HUD remain. This is a deliberate quiet interval.
camera: Reposition the one camera to the lower-level section only after opacity passes 0.98.
fog: The entire exterior-to-basement scene change is concealed.

title: Work / lower level
seen: A compact lower-level section reveals work space, the large-tree court, a separate open-to-sky access court and a distinct garage-ramp edge. “Work, with room to think.” leads to Explore.
camera: Hold a mild elevated view, matching the main house front orientation as far as plan visibility permits; no ongoing spin.
fog: Fog consumes external section edges and hides everything beyond the selected floor.
modules: world.js, details.js, program.js, characters.js, environment.js, main.js

title: Lower level leaves
seen: The same section drifts up, with the table and floor disappearing first. Its caption and leader withdraw.
camera: Truck the camera gently down relative to the held section, with unchanged azimuth.
fog: Rising mist erases the lower geometry before the object leaves view.

title: Morning pause
seen: The viewport is empty warm-grey fog with four quiet corners.
camera: Complete the move to the ground-floor camera while fully masked.
fog: The basement is removed and the ground-floor section becomes ready entirely out of sight.

title: Coffee / ground floor
seen: The teak-floored living room appears with the glazed doors, brass lanterns and two small tables. “Coffee. A table. An unhurried start.” accompanies the café hours, 08:00–18:00.
camera: Hold a shallow elevated frontal camera; keep the complete room inside the safe scene area.
fog: Fog obscures the cut edges and upper-floor absence.
modules: world.js, windows.js, details.js, characters.js, program.js, environment.js, main.js

title: The morning clears
seen: The café moves upward and its floor is veiled; all in-world copy has faded.
camera: Slow vertical travel only, retaining the café perspective.
fog: Mist erases the table legs and section perimeter first.

title: Afternoon pause
seen: An empty afternoon atmosphere separates café and courtyard.
camera: Move the camera to the court overview only inside opaque fog.
fog: No room substitution or camera jump is visible.

title: Read / first floor
seen: The approved double-height court returns: olive tree, three nest pendants, sandstone and louvred teak. A library glimpse is a proposed adjacent use. The caption reads “Read. Talk. Let an idea take its time.”
camera: Hold the court overview established by approved board 04.
fog: Fog masks external walls and limits the view to one section.
modules: world.js, details.js, characters.js, program.js, environment.js, main.js

title: Who’s inside
seen: A slightly wider court view makes space for Founders / Artists / Music / Play. Founders is selected; two people talk over a notebook. Labels and short callout lines live in empty fog.
camera: Ease back once, then hold the camera throughout all four selection states.
fog: A small local haze crossfade may hide activity replacement; never mask an unexpected architectural change.

title: Into sundown
seen: The screen becomes empty violet-grey fog. The rejected pass that invented a new terrace was replaced.
camera: Transition the single camera to the terrace view only while opaque.
fog: The court and activities disappear before the terrace is introduced.

title: Terrace / sundown
seen: The full narrow terracotta terrace, white parapet openings, teak side room and timber bench appear. Three people talk under restrained warm lights. “The day opens into evening.”
camera: Hold a gentle downward view with the entire side room inside the image.
fog: Fog hides all neighbours, lower floors and the section base.
modules: world.js, details.js, characters.js, program.js, environment.js, main.js

title: Evening pause
seen: Empty slate-blue atmosphere deepens toward night.
camera: Return to the exact exterior camera registration while masked.
fog: The floor sections can rejoin their parent house here.

title: Coming back together
seen: The familiar facade comes back almost closed, with narrow seams and the first warm windows. The initial roof separation resolves as scrolling continues.
camera: Use the exterior master camera; do not orbit. Register the building to frame 03 in the actual build.
fog: Fog at the base conceals the joins and returning ground contact.

title: A club by night
seen: The closed house glows softly. The copy explains evening hours, 18:00–23:00, and membership-dependent access. No programme frequency is invented.
camera: Hold the original street camera and closed facade dimensions.
fog: Dark fog hides the neighbourhood and keeps attention on windows.

title: Night pause
seen: The house vanishes into empty deep-blue mist.
camera: Move to a shallow view of the membership objects after full masking.
fog: All house-to-membership object changes happen unseen.

title: Three ways to belong
seen: Visit, Regular and House appear as three furniture compositions on small sandstone fragments. Each lists inclusions, “Needs —” and Book a call. Requirements remain visibly unconfirmed.
camera: Hold one shallow arc view; the objects share a scale and ground plane.
fog: Fog eats the fragments’ bases so they belong to the same world.
modules: world.js, characters.js, environment.js, main.js; proposed membership data

title: Regular / selected
seen: The Regular object brightens subtly with an underline and orange focus dot. The other two remain readable. The helper line says “For a more regular rhythm.”
camera: No camera movement or geometry change on hover, focus or selection.
fog: Fog stays constant; it is not used to conceal the other tiers’ copy.

title: One last breath
seen: The three objects withdraw. “Stay a while” replaces the scroll hint as the final empty interval arrives.
camera: Set the final invitation camera while masked.
fog: This hides the change from three tier objects to one chair.

title: There’s room for you
seen: One empty teak chair and one petal form the final in-world invitation. “There’s room for you. Tell us what you’re building. Book a call →.” The top-right action remains.
camera: Settle and hold. Clamp progress at the end; do not loop visitors away from booking.
fog: Fog leaves the chair alone and suppresses the floor fragment’s edge.
